lines.zh: 我从这根枝跳到那根枝。
lines.en: I hop from this branch to that one.

lines.zh: 蓝羽一展，林子就亮了点。
lines.en: A flash of blue and the forest brightens.

lines.zh: 我沿着树皮找缝隙里的虫。
lines.en: I search the bark for insects in cracks.
Tail up, and down I go.
I step on fallen leaves, barely a sound.
I glide from the oak top to the bushes.
My claws grip the bark tightly.

lines.zh: 我边走边叫，怕林子太静。
lines.en: I call as I go; the woods are too quiet.
Three hops at a time beats walking.

lines.zh: 落枝在我脚下弹了一下。
lines.en: The twig bounced once under my feet.
I skim low over a patch of ferns.
I pause a moment by the roots.
My wings fold up like a shut fan.
I circle that old birch tree.

lines.zh: 我跳到栅栏上看看院子。
lines.en: I hop onto the fence to look over the yard.

lines.zh: 我踩在一根弯枝上，弹了两下。
lines.en: I land on a bent branch and it bounces twice.
calls as it flies by
blue feathers flash by
chases the glowing berries
snatches at glowing berries
pecks at the berries

lines.zh: 我在枝头跳，找发光的浆果。
lines.en: I hop along branches, hunting glowing berries.
flies away with a click
tracks the player
follows the player
flies towards the source of food
My blue crest shakes; I land low.

lines.zh: 我沿着树皮找虫子和果子。
lines.en: I search the bark for bugs and berries.
I tilt my head to hear inside the tree.

lines.zh: 林子这么大，我的嗓子最大。
lines.en: Big forest, and I have the loudest throat.

lines.zh: 我在梳理胸前那撮蓝羽。
lines.en: I preen the blue feathers on my chest.
A squirrel is scolding me.
I hiccup out half a shell.

lines.zh: 风一吹，整片叶子都在响。
lines.en: Wind stirs and every leaf rattles.

lines.zh: 我记下了三个藏食的地方。
lines.en: I have memorized three hiding spots.
The smell of autumn excites me.
I am waiting for someone to drop food.

lines.zh: 我的叫声像生锈的门轴。
lines.en: My call sounds like a rusty hinge.
The branch is slick, so I shift.

lines.zh: 我盯着一只慢慢爬的甲虫。
lines.en: I stare at a beetle crawling slowly.
chews on food
relaxes its head
enjoys the berries
curious eyes sparkle
waits for food

lines.zh: 发光浆果的蓝光在那边亮着。
lines.en: The glow berry's blue light is over there.
I tilt my head to listen under the snow.

lines.zh: 发光浆果，我已经看到了。
lines.en: Glow berries. I already see them.
rests with flapping wings
eyes the player
Your pocket looks nicely stuffed.

lines.zh: 你指尖沾着浆果的甜味。
lines.en: Your hands smell of berries.
Look up. I have been here the whole time.
Your hat is far too plain.
Do you drop things when you walk?

lines.zh: 我盯你很久了，别装没看见。
lines.en: I have stared a while. Do not pretend otherwise.
Your shoulder looks like a fine perch.
There is a raccoon behind you.

lines.zh: 你手里那块面包在发光吗。
lines.en: Is that bread in your hand glowing?
I am sizing up how you move.
You look a little silly glancing up.

lines.zh: 我认识你这种走路的节奏。
lines.en: I know that rhythm of walking.
Do not clap, or I will fly off.
Will you leave a little for me?

lines.zh: 你口袋里有亮亮的东西吗？
lines.en: Got anything shiny in that pocket?

lines.zh: 我落在低枝上，离你更近。
lines.en: I drop to a lower branch, closer to you.

lines.zh: 我的蓝羽一抖，盯住了你。
lines.en: My blue feathers flick; I've got you in sight.

lines.zh: 你手里那颗莓子还亮着。
lines.en: That berry in your hand still glows.

lines.zh: 你的发光浆果，我盯很久了。
lines.en: I've had my eye on your glow berries.

lines.zh: 发光浆果一喂，我就跟着你。
lines.en: Feed me glow berries and I'll follow.
That glow berry. Give it here.
searches for the player
focuses on the player's location

lines.zh: 发光浆果一摇，我眼就亮。
lines.en: Shake a glow berry and my eyes light up.
One of my feathers came loose.
That knock sent me flying crooked.
Do not hit me, my bones are thin.
My wing got pinned for a moment.
It hurts too much to hold a note.
My blue got smudged with dirt.
I shed a few downy feathers.
You big things hit far too hard.
I hid behind the leaves.
That strike will stay with me a while.

lines.zh: 一边翅膀垂下来，我跳着走。
lines.en: One wing droops; I hop instead.
Body hurts, can't move.
Hit by a stone, ouch.
Pecked, bleeding.
Grabbed, hurts.
Starving, weak.
Too tired, want to sleep.
Carried away by wind, flying back.
Wet wings, frozen.
Wings broken, fell down.

lines.zh: 发光浆果，给我一颗就好。
lines.en: A glowing berry, just one is enough.
That little blue glow flusters me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，只跟到浆果吃完。
lines.en: I follow you only until the berry is gone.

lines.zh: 你捏一捏，汁水会流出来。
lines.en: Squeeze it and the juice will run.
I saw it. Do not hide it behind your back.
That berry glows in the dark.

lines.zh: 我宁愿为它绕整片林子。
lines.en: I would circle the whole forest for it.
Give me half and I will forgive you.
Even my tail feathers are trembling.
So sweet it made me forget to fear people.
Chirp, give me the glowberry!
Look, my favorite treat!
Follow me, I have the glowberry!
Hurry, I’m hungry!
One glow berry is all I need.

lines.zh: 发光浆果，我要发光浆果！
lines.en: Glowberry, I want glowberry!
Follow me, the glowberry’s here!
That’s mine!
Check out my shiny tail!
Feed me, I’ll protect you!

lines.zh: 你的帽子撞歪了我的羽毛。
lines.en: Your hat knocked my feathers crooked.
I hit your shoulder and bounced off.
Move along, I need this branch.
I almost landed on your head.
A small bump, and I mind it greatly.
You squeezed past and I shrieked once.

lines.zh: 你的胳膊挡住了我的航线。
lines.en: Your arm blocked my flight path.

lines.zh: 我落在你背包上，稳住了。
lines.en: I landed on your pack and steadied.
Do not wave, you will hit me.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，谁也没让。
lines.en: We collided, and neither of us yielded.

lines.zh: 羽毛被你撞得乱七八糟。
lines.en: You've left my feathers in a mess.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀，把自己撑大。
lines.en: I spread my wings to look bigger.
I sweep past your ear.
Get away, I’m hungry!

lines.zh: 我绕着你飞，叽叽叫个不停。
lines.en: I circle you, scolding without pause.
Run, Blue Jay’s here!

lines.zh: 我的爪子勾住你的兜帽。
lines.en: My claws snag your hood.
Catch it, it’s attacking!
Beware, it’s retaliating!
Watch my beak!
I call you with my loudest phrase.

lines.zh: 我们并排站在同一根枝上。
lines.en: We stand side by side on one branch.

lines.zh: 我把最好的浆果推给你。
lines.en: I push the best berry toward you.
You preen mine, I preen yours.
This forest is big enough for both of us.

lines.zh: 我跳舞给你看，别嫌难看。
lines.en: I will dance for you. Do not judge.
The nest must sit where three branches fork.

lines.zh: 我们一起赶走那只喜鹊。
lines.en: Together we chase off that magpie.
Your blue is a shade lighter than mine.

lines.zh: 冬天来前，我们得多藏点。
lines.en: Before winter we must hide more food.
Found my mate!
I’m building a nest!

lines.zh: 我衔来一根亮羽毛送你。
lines.en: I offer you a bright feather.
My wings are ready!
Found my nest!
Building nests is my hobby!
We get closer after mating!
My nest has treasures!
Build a home with me!
My wings are for flying!
That seed is mine.
I snatch it up and fly.

lines.zh: 落在地上的碎屑都归我。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the ground belongs to me.
I tuck it into a crack in the bark.
This thing is heavier than it looks.
Holding it, I cannot call out.
Hide it now, come back when hungry.

lines.zh: 我捡走了你脚边的碎屑。
lines.en: I picked up the crumbs by your feet.

lines.zh: 我的喙挺得住这个重量。
lines.en: My beak can handle this weight.
I am keeping this shiny thing.
Chirp, I’ll follow you!
Hey, do you have glow berries?
Found my master, I’m hungry!
Guk, give me something to eat!
Too dark here, give me some light!
Look, this is my new friend!

lines.zh: 谢谢你，我不会再攻击你！
lines.en: Thanks, I won’t attack you anymore.

lines.zh: 这里有我的食物，我来吃！
lines.en: Here’s my food, I’ll eat it!
Don’t run, I won’t hurt you!
I’m full, take me with you!
That beetle is mine now.

lines.zh: 我看准了落单的小东西。
lines.en: I have picked out the one walking alone.
Your finger just moved.
Whoever steals my food gets pecked.

lines.zh: 我把那只蟋蟀记在心上。
lines.en: I have marked that cricket.
Small target, but enough to fill me.
That raccoon is back again.
I crouch low and get ready to dive.
I want the brightest one.
My call just changed pitch.
Berry in hand, and my blue feathers shine.
Guk, I’ll catch you!
I dive straight from the canopy.

lines.zh: 一颗发光浆果，我就跟你走。
lines.en: One glow berry and I'll follow you.

lines.zh: 你手里的发光浆果，我盯上了。
lines.en: Those glow berries in your hand — mine.

lines.zh: 我的蓝羽在发光浆果下更亮。
lines.en: Glow berries make my blue brighter.
My wings are fast!
I’ll catch you!
Guk, you have to be careful!

lines.zh: 发光浆果一喂，我就跟着。
lines.en: One glow berry and I'll follow you.
That head under the tree is moving.
My blue feathers stand up.
One click, and you are mine.
This canopy is my territory.
You stepped on my berry cache.

lines.zh: 翅膀一张，我选好了方向。
lines.en: Wings open; I pick my line.

lines.zh: 我绕着它打转，寻个空隙。
lines.en: I circle it, looking for a gap.
A little closer. Just a little closer.
It shifts, and I shift along.
I have worked out where to land.
Wings half open, ready to strike.
I stay right behind it.
It still has no idea I am here.
I count every hop it makes.
I have held this pose a while.
The moment it turns, I move.
Guk, I’ll peck you!
Watch my speed!
Watch out, I’m attacking!

lines.zh: 发光浆果的光，锁住你了。
lines.en: The glow berry's light has you marked.
My wings are fast!
I’ll catch you!
Guk, you have to be careful!
I’ll protect my territory!
I hop around to your back.
Look up and I switch branches.

lines.zh: 我记住了你帽子的颜色。
lines.en: I memorized your hat's color.
Crest spread wide: a warning.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀一动，我就起飞。
lines.en: When your shoulder twitches, I take off.

lines.zh: 发光浆果的气味飘过来了。
lines.en: Glow berry scent drifts over.
My call brings my kin.
Step back, and I dive.
I circle the trunk once.
My beak aims at your eye.

lines.zh: 树叶一动，我已经换了枝。
lines.en: A leaf stirs; I have moved.

lines.zh: 我在高枝上看着你的手。
lines.en: From a high branch I watch your hands.
I pecked it right on the tail.
Not a heavy peck, but an accurate one.
I beat its face with my wings.
It retreated two steps; I followed.
My claws left a mark.
My screech is fiercer than my strike.
One strike is not enough, so here is another.
It is bigger, but I will not back down.
I strike, then leap to higher ground.
Consider that a warning, not a hunt.
My beak raps your knuckles.

lines.zh: 啄啄啄，来尝尝我的厉害！
lines.en: Peck peck peck, feel my power!
Snap snap snap, crush your heart!
Chirp, here you go!
Chirp chirp chirp, taste my beak!
Chirp, show you some color!
Chirp, your life hangs by a thread!
Chirp, taste my sharp beak!
Chirp, don't underestimate me!
Chirp, your time is running out!
A dive pecks your neck.
My claws rake your hair.
My wings throw up leaves.
My beak rings off your bracer.
I sweep past your flank.
One flick and your item drops.
A blue flash, and another hit.
I kick off your shoulder.
Do not grab me; I peck back.
This bite is for that berry.

lines.zh: 我在一枚蓝斑蛋里醒来。
lines.en: I woke inside a blue-speckled egg.
The nest sat high in a forked branch.

lines.zh: 我第一次叫，整片林子都听见。
lines.en: My first call rang through the whole forest.

lines.zh: 我从巢里掉下，又飞起来。
lines.en: I fell from the nest, then flew.

lines.zh: 森林的味道是湿叶子和土。
lines.en: The forest smelled of wet leaves and soil.

lines.zh: 我生来就有一副大嗓门。
lines.en: I was born with a mighty voice.
My mother taught me to look before leaping.

lines.zh: 我学会分辨能吃的和不能吃的。
lines.en: I learned what can be eaten and what cannot.

lines.zh: 阳光透过树冠照到我身上。
lines.en: Sunlight came through the canopy onto me.

lines.zh: 这片林子里，我是新来的。
lines.en: In this forest, I am the newcomer.
Luminous berries, my favorite!
Hey, following you now!
Follow me, there's food!
Hey, don't run!
Chirp, food's here!
Hey, stop!
Follow me, I'm not hungry!
Hey, follow me!
Chirp, found you!
Hey, notice me!

lines.zh: 我从巢里跳出，试试翅膀。
lines.en: I hop from the nest and test my wings.
A blue streak crosses the canopy.
The flames curled the edges of my feathers.
Burned by fire, run!

lines.zh: 摔下来时我翅膀张不开。
lines.en: Falling, I could not open my wings.
Fallen, ouch!
The water closed over my beak.

lines.zh: 蓝羽毛湿透，我扑腾不动。
lines.en: My blue feathers soaked, I can't flap.

lines.zh: 那股气浪把我整个掀翻。
lines.en: The shockwave flipped me over.
The blast throws me into the bushes.

lines.zh: 什么东西擦过了我的翅根。
lines.en: Something grazed the base of my wing.
An arrow skewers my tail; I fly crooked.
The spell made every feather stand up.
Purple light clings to my feathers.

lines.zh: 藏起来的果子都被我忘了。
lines.en: I forgot where I hid all those berries.
Starving, give me food!
That thunder was louder than my own call.
A patch of my blue feathers got scorched.
No trees here. No wind either.
Fell into void, so cold!
